title: Loom Journey
description: An ordered, untimed walkthrough of a diagram. Each step references a node; the renderer highlights nodes one at a time as the reader advances.

id.description: Journey identifier. Should match the filename without extension.

description.description: Markdown allowed. Renders above the step list.

diagram.description: ID of the diagram this journey walks through. Every step.node must exist in this diagram.

node.description: ID of a node in the journey's diagram. Validated by the server / MCP tools.

description.description: Markdown allowed. Narrates what happens at this step.

code_refs.description: Optional step-level code refs. Use to narrow focus to a specific symbol within the node's code; if redundant with the node's code_refs, omit.

symbol.description: Function, class, or component name. Preferred over lines because it survives refactors.

lines.description: Line range(s) like '1-80' or '12,45-50'. Use only when no symbol applies.

signature_hint.description: Canonical signature line captured from the symbol's source. Filled by `loom-spec validate --capture`. Drift detection compares this against the current source; mismatch = warning.
